title: Accuracy of a novel minimally invasive registration method for dynamic navigation-assisted zygomatic implant surgery: a pilot prospective single-arm study
html: This prospective single-arm study enrolled 10 patients with 33 zygomatic implants (ZIs) to prospectively evaluate the accuracy of a novel minimally invasive registration method for dynamic navigation-assisted ZI placement. A patient-specific minimally invasive registration plate was designed, featuring a base plate fixed with four pins and bilateral wings to position registration points adjacent to the zygomatic bone. Intraoperative registration was performed using this plate during dynamic navigation-guided ZI surgery.
